fields.title: Nicaragua SISCAE procurement procedure record
fields.description: One record per procurement procedure matching the search filters. A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when the search itself fails or matches zero procedures.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The resolved filters used for this search (keyword, numero, estados, institucion/institucionValue, departamento/departamentoValue, resultadosItems).

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which strategy emitted this record (S1-jsf-portlet-grid, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

tipoProcedimiento.title: Procedure type
tipoProcedimiento.description: SISCAE's Spanish-language procurement modality, e.g. 'LICITACION PUBLICA', 'LICITACION O CONCURSO PUBLICO INTERNACIONAL', 'CONCURSO PARA CONSULTORES'.

numeroProcedimiento.title: Procedure number
numeroProcedimiento.description: The institution's own reference number for this procedure, e.g. '16/2026'.

estado.title: Status
estado.description: Current status as shown by SISCAE, e.g. 'Vigente' (open), 'Adjudicado' (awarded).

codigoSigaf.title: SIGAF code
codigoSigaf.description: Government financial-system (SIGAF) reference code, when assigned. Frequently '#' (not yet assigned) upstream -- passed through as-is.

publicacion.title: Publication date
publicacion.description: The date this procedure was published, as shown by SISCAE.

cierre.title: Closing date/time
cierre.description: The offer-submission closing date/time, as shown by SISCAE (label text varies slightly by status, e.g. 'Cierre' vs a status-specific variant -- this field normalizes to whichever one is present).

ultimaActualizacion.title: Last updated
ultimaActualizacion.description: When SISCAE itself last updated this procedure's record.

institucion.title: Institution
institucion.description: The government institution running this procedure.

clasificaciones.title: Classifications
clasificaciones.description: Procurement category/classification code(s) and description(s), e.g. 'Servicios de construccion general (72130000)'.

objeto.title: Object / title
objeto.description: The free-text description of what is being procured.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for every result -- rows missing a given column render blank.
